# Red Points

> Red Points is an AI-powered brand protection platform that detects and removes counterfeits, piracy, impersonation, and IP infringements across digital channels.

Red Points provides comprehensive online brand protection solutions covering marketplaces, social media, domains, mobile apps, and video platforms. The platform combines automated detection with enforcement services including DMCA takedowns, domain takedowns, and revenue recovery.

## Key Topics

- Brand Protection
- Anti-Piracy
- Counterfeit Removal
- Domain Management
- Impersonation Removal
- Marketplace Protection
- Social Media Protection
- DMCA Takedown
- Trademark Monitoring
- Brand Intelligence
- Mobile App Protection
- Domain Takedown
- Copyright Infringement
- Gray Market Protection
- Revenue Recovery

## Core Brand Protection Solutions

- [Red Points' AI Brand Protection Platform](https://www.redpoints.com): Red Points AI platform for brand protection, counterfeits, piracy, and impersonation removal
- [Brand Protection Software](https://www.redpoints.com/brand-protection-software): Brand protection software for counterfeit removal and marketplace protection
- [Brand Intelligence Software](https://www.redpoints.com/software/brand-intelligence-software): Brand Intelligence software for trademark monitoring and IP protection

## Platform & Channel Protection

- [Marketplace Protection](https://www.redpoints.com/software/marketplaces): Marketplace protection covering 5,000+ platforms for counterfeit listing removal
- [Social Media Protection](https://www.redpoints.com/software/social-media): Social media protection for fake profiles and counterfeit detection
- [Mobile App Protection](https://www.redpoints.com/software/mobile-apps): Brand protection for mobile apps on official and unofficial stores
- [Social Video Growth](https://www.redpoints.com/social-video-growth): Video protection and monetization for YouTube, Facebook, and video platforms
- [Ad Protection](https://www.redpoints.com/software/ad-protection): Ad protection for fraudulent ads on search engines and social media platforms

## Intellectual Property Protection

- [Anti-Piracy Solutions](https://www.redpoints.com/solution-piracy): Anti-piracy solution for tracking and removing illegal audiovisual content
- [Domain Management Software](https://www.redpoints.com/domain-management): Domain management software for detecting and enforcing trademark-infringing domains
- [Domain Management](https://www.redpoints.com/software/domains): Domain management for detecting and enforcing trademark-exploiting domains
- [Copyright Infringement Protection](https://www.redpoints.com/usecase/copyright-infringement-protection): Copyright infringement protection with quick detection and DMCA removal

## Enforcement & Removal Services

- [Impersonation Removal](https://www.redpoints.com/impersonation-removal): Impersonation removal service for fake accounts, phishing sites, and fraudulent ads
- [Domain Takedown Service](https://www.redpoints.com/usecase/domain-takedown): Domain takedown service for phishing sites and fraudulent domain removal
- [DMCA Takedown Services](https://www.redpoints.com/usecase/dmca-takedown-service): DMCA takedown service for content theft enforcement and IP rights protection
- [Revenue Recovery Program](https://www.redpoints.com/revenue-recovery-program): Revenue recovery program with zero-cost litigation and seller removal enforcement

## Specialized Protection Services

- [Gray Market Protection](https://www.redpoints.com/gray-market): Gray market protection for unauthorized sellers and parallel imports
